title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Daniel 2: the king's forgotten dream, the great image of gold, silver, bronze and iron, and the stone that filled the earth.

questions.text: In which year of Nebuchadnezzar's reign did he dream the dreams that troubled him?
questions.explanation: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar he dreamed dreams, his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

answers.text: The third year
The first year
The second year
The twelfth year

questions.text: What did the king threaten if the wise men did not make known the dream and its interpretation?
questions.explanation: The king said that if they did not make known the dream and its interpretation, they would be cut in pieces and their houses would be made a dunghill.

answers.text: They would be cut in pieces and their houses made a dunghill
They would be cast into a burning fiery furnace
They would be sent away from Babylon
They would be cast into the den of lions

questions.text: What did the Chaldeans say about who could show the king such a thing?
questions.explanation: They said it was a rare thing the king required, and that there was no other who could show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

answers.text: Only the king himself could, if he remembered it
Only a prophet of the God of Israel could
Any Chaldean could, if given more time
No one, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh

questions.text: Who was the captain of the king's guard who had gone out to kill the wise men?
questions.explanation: Daniel answered with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

answers.text: Ashpenaz
Arioch
Belteshazzar
Abednego

questions.text: Whom did Daniel tell about the matter, so that they would ask mercies of the God of heaven?
questions.explanation: Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, so that they would ask mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret.

answers.text: Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah
Arioch and the king's counselors
The magicians and the enchanters
The Chaldeans and the soothsayers

questions.text: How was the secret revealed to Daniel?
questions.explanation: The secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night, and then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

answers.text: By a voice from the sky at noon
By a writing on the wall
In a vision of the night
By a man clothed in linen

questions.text: Of what was the head of the great image made?
questions.explanation: The image's head was of fine gold, its breast and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze.

answers.text: Silver
Fine gold
Bronze
Iron mixed with clay

questions.text: What struck the image on its feet and broke them in pieces?
questions.explanation: A stone was cut out without hands and struck the image on its feet of iron and clay, breaking them in pieces.

answers.text: A great wind from the sea
An iron rod from the sky
A flood of water
A stone cut out without hands

questions.text: What did Daniel say about the fourth kingdom?
questions.explanation: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, and as iron that crushes, it will break in pieces and crush.

answers.text: It will be the weakest of all the kingdoms
It will be made wholly of potters' clay
It will be strong as iron, breaking in pieces and crushing
It will never rule outside Babylon

questions.text: What did the king do for Daniel after he made the dream known?
questions.explanation: The king made Daniel great, gave him many great gifts, made him rule over the whole province of Babylon, and made him chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

answers.text: He made him ruler of the province of Babylon
He sent him back to Judah with gifts
He made him master of his eunuchs
He gave him a chain of gold and nothing more
